title: Mumbai police, Skype par aao, FIR ka darr

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, main Andheri police station se Inspector Patil bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe ek FIR darj hui hai.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Kaun si FIR? Maine kuch nahi kiya.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke bank account se illegal transaction hua hai. Abhi Skype pe video call pe aaiye, statement record karna hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ye matter bahut confidential hai, apne parivaar ko bhi mat batana. Call cut kiya to turant arrest hoga.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Apna saara balance is verification account mein daal dijiye, check hone ke baad wapas aa jayega.
